propositions: origin/main HEAD violates the C901 complexity ratchet baseline (increased=1) due to commit aec1 raising PydanticAIRunner.run cyclomatic complexity from 24 to 25 via a success-path try/except block.

Commit c9f7 added the C901 ratchet gate, but the gate was verified against a pre-aec1 patchset; Gerrit's rebase-without-reverify stacked the gate on aec1 without re-verifying, creating a blocking quality gate failure.

The success-path try/except in PydanticAIRunner.run that captures usage_log.run_shape and shape_only must be extracted into a module-level helper (_merge_success_run_shape) to reduce complexity back to <=24.
The extracted _merge_success_run_shape helper must preserve the key merge behavior, swallow run_shape/shape_only failures with a warning log, and leave the authoritative usage dict unchanged.
After refactoring, python3 scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check and make lint must exit 0 on origin/main with no new baseline regeneration.
